alignments.note: Supplied subject pronoun for a participial clause that writes no subject. Rule 25 forbids giving it to the participle מֵקִים, since a participle in a verbless clause takes only the copula, and rule 20's closing sentence marks a referential subject pronoun answering to no morpheme added. The competing reading folds it into the לַיהוָה unit as a realization of the one proper name the verse writes; that name stands in the later causal clause as the possessor of the pillars and is realized only inside the fused genitive Jehovah's, so it is not a subject the ASV resumes, and rule 10 keeps the antecedent of verse 7 out of this verse's account.
